ko.title: 10년물 국채 금리 5.24% 기록, 19년 만에 최고치: 시장과 대출 비용에 미치는 영향

segments.src: The 10-year U.S.
segments.tr: 미국 10년물

segments.src: Treasury yield closed at **5.244%**, its highest level since 2007.
segments.tr: 국채 금리가 2007년 이후 최고 수준인 **5.244%**로 마감했습니다.

segments.src: Traders are also pricing roughly a **70% chance** of another Federal Reserve rate hike in October, according to market-implied probabilities.
segments.tr: 시장 내재 확률에 따르면 트레이더들은 10월 연방준비제도의 추가 금리 인상 가능성을 약 **70%**로 반영하고 있습니다.

segments.src: In the same session, gold fell about **3.7%**.
segments.tr: 같은 거래일에 금 가격은 약 **3.7%** 하락했습니다.

segments.src: Together, these moves show how quickly expectations for interest rates can shift.
segments.tr: 이러한 움직임은 금리에 대한 기대감이 얼마나 빠르게 변화할 수 있는지 보여줍니다.

segments.src: This article explains what the bond market may be signaling and how higher yields can reach everyday finances.
segments.tr: 본 문서에서는 채권 시장이 무엇을 시사하고 있는지, 그리고 높은 금리가 일상적인 개인 금융에 어떤 영향을 미치는지 설명합니다.

segments.src: It is general information, not personalized financial advice.
segments.tr: 이 정보는 일반적인 정보 제공을 목적으로 하며, 맞춤형 재무 자문이 아닙니다.

segments.src: ## What the 10-Year Yield Measures
segments.tr: ## 10년물 금리가 의미하는 것

segments.src: The 10-year Treasury yield is the annual return investors earn by lending money to the U.S.
segments.tr: 10년물 국채 금리는 투자자가 미국

segments.src: government for a decade.
segments.tr: 정부에 10년 동안 돈을 빌려주고 받는 연간 수익률입니다.

segments.src: Bond prices and yields move in opposite directions.
segments.tr: 채권 가격과 금리는 반대 방향으로 움직입니다.

segments.src: When investors sell Treasuries, prices fall and yields rise.
segments.tr: 투자자들이 국채를 매도하면 가격은 떨어지고 금리는 상승합니다.

segments.src: The 10-year yield is often called the benchmark for global borrowing costs.
segments.tr: 10년물 금리는 흔히 글로벌 차입 비용의 벤치마크로 불립니다.

segments.src: Many other rates are priced relative to it, including mortgages, corporate bonds and some business loans.
segments.tr: 주택담보대출, 회사채, 일부 기업 대출을 포함한 다른 많은 금리가 이 금리를 기준으로 책정됩니다.

segments.src: ## Why Yields Are Rising
segments.tr: ## 금리가 상승하는 이유

segments.src: Several forces can push long-term yields higher at the same time:
segments.tr: 여러 요인이 동시에 장기 금리를 상승시킬 수 있습니다:

segments.src: - **Rate expectations.** If markets expect the Fed to keep rates higher for longer, or to raise them again, investors demand higher yields on longer-dated bonds.
segments.tr: - **금리 전망.** 시장이 연준의 고금리 기조 유지 기간이 더 길어지거나 금리를 다시 인상할 것으로 예상하면, 투자자들은 더 장기의 채권에 대해 더 높은 금리를 요구합니다.

segments.src: - **Inflation concerns.** Investors want compensation for the risk that inflation erodes the value of fixed payments.
segments.tr: - **인플레이션 우려.** 투자자들은 인플레이션으로 인해 고정 이자 지급액의 가치가 하락하는 위험에 대한 보상을 원합니다.

segments.src: - **Heavy government borrowing.** A larger supply of Treasuries can require higher yields to attract buyers.
segments.tr: - **막대한 정부 차입.** 국채 공급량이 늘어나면 매수자를 유인하기 위해 더 높은 금리가 필요할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Term premium.** Investors may ask for extra yield to hold long-term debt when the outlook is uncertain.
segments.tr: - **기간 프리미엄.** 전망이 불확실할 때 투자자들은 장기 채권을 보유하는 대가로 추가 금리를 요구할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: No single factor explains a move like this.
segments.tr: 단 하나의 요인만으로 이러한 움직임을 설명할 수는 없습니다.

segments.src: Analysts often disagree about which one matters most.
segments.tr: 분석가들 사이에서도 어떤 요인이 가장 중요한지에 대한 의견이 종종 엇갈립니다.

segments.src: ## Why Gold Fell Sharply
segments.tr: ## 금 가격이 급락한 이유

segments.src: Gold pays no interest.
segments.tr: 금은 이자를 지급하지 않습니다.

segments.src: When Treasury yields rise, holding gold becomes relatively less attractive compared with bonds that pay a rising, low-risk return.
segments.tr: 국채 금리가 상승하면 상승하는 저위험 수익을 제공하는 채권에 비해 금 보유의 매력도가 상대적으로 떨어집니다.

segments.src: A stronger dollar can add to the pressure.
segments.tr: 강달러 현상 역시 하락 압력을 더할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: A 3.7% one-day drop is large for gold, and it suggests that traders were reacting strongly to the rate outlook.
segments.tr: 금 가격이 하루 만에 3.7% 하락한 것은 큰 폭이며, 이는 트레이더들이 금리 전망에 강력하게 반응했음을 시사합니다.

segments.src: One day's move is not a trend, though, and prices can reverse.
segments.tr: 하지만 하루 동안의 움직임이 트렌드를 의미하지는 않으며, 가격은 반전될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## How Higher Yields Reach Your Wallet
segments.tr: ## 고금리가 지갑 사정에 미치는 영향

segments.src: ### Car loans
segments.tr: ### 자동차 대출

segments.src: Auto loan rates tend to follow broader market rates.
segments.tr: 자동차 대출 금리는 광범위한 시장 금리를 따르는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: Higher yields can mean higher monthly payments for new borrowers.
segments.tr: 금리가 높아지면 신규 대출자의 월 납입금이 늘어날 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Existing fixed-rate loans generally do not change.
segments.tr: 기존 고정금리 대출은 일반적으로 변동하지 않습니다.

segments.src: ### Credit cards
segments.tr: ### 신용카드

segments.src: Most credit card rates are variable and tied to the Fed's benchmark rate.
segments.tr: 대부분의 신용카드 금리는 변동금리이며 연준의 기준금리에 연동됩니다.

segments.src: If the Fed raises rates, card APRs usually rise within a billing cycle or two.
segments.tr: 연준이 금리를 올리면 신용카드 APR은 보통 한두 청구 주기 이내에 상승합니다.

segments.src: Carrying a balance becomes more expensive.
segments.tr: 잔액을 이월하여 보유하는 비용이 더 비싸집니다.

segments.src: ### Mortgages
segments.tr: ### 주택담보대출

segments.src: Fixed mortgage rates track the 10-year yield closely.
segments.tr: 고정 주택담보대출 금리는 10년물 금리를 밀접하게 추종합니다.

segments.src: Higher yields typically push new mortgage rates up, which can reduce affordability for buyers and limit refinancing options.
segments.tr: 금리가 상승하면 일반적으로 신규 주택담보대출 금리가 올라가며, 이는 매수자의 구매력을 떨어뜨리고 재융자 옵션을 제한할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ### Savings and CDs
segments.tr: ### 예금 및 CD

segments.src: There is an upside.
segments.tr: 긍정적인 면도 있습니다.

segments.src: Higher rates often lift yields on high-yield savings accounts, certificates of deposit and money market funds.
segments.tr: 높아진 금리는 고금리 예금 계좌, 양도성예금증서(CD), 머니마켓펀드(MMF)의 수익률을 끌어올리는 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: Rates vary by institution, so comparing offers is worthwhile.
segments.tr: 금리는 금융기관마다 다르므로 상품 조건들을 비교해 볼 만한 가치가 있습니다.

segments.src: ### Retirement accounts
segments.tr: ### 은퇴 계좌

segments.src: The effect on retirement savings is mixed:
segments.tr: 은퇴 자금에 미치는 영향은 복합적입니다:

segments.src: - **Existing bond holdings** can lose market value when yields rise, including bond funds in a 401(k) or IRA.
segments.tr: - **기존 채권 보유 자산**은 401(k)나 IRA 내의 채권 펀드를 포함하여 금리가 상승할 때 시장 가치가 하락할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Stocks** may come under pressure, since higher yields make future corporate earnings worth less today and give investors a competitive alternative.
segments.tr: - **주식**은 높은 금리로 인해 미래 기업 이익의 현재 가치가 낮아지고 투자자들에게 경쟁력 있는 대안을 제공하므로 하락 압력을 받을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **New savings** can buy bonds at higher yields, which improves future income potential.
segments.tr: - **신규 저축액**으로는 더 높은 수익률의 채권을 매수할 수 있어 향후 소득 잠재력이 개선됩니다.

segments.src: Long-term investors who hold bonds to maturity still receive the stated interest and principal, unless the issuer defaults.
segments.tr: 채권을 만기까지 보유하는 장기 투자자는 발행자가 부도를 내지 않는 한 명시된 이자와 원금을 그대로 받습니다.

segments.src: That is very unlikely for U.S.
segments.tr: 미국

segments.src: Treasuries.
segments.tr: 국채의 경우 그럴 가능성은 매우 낮습니다.

segments.src: ## What to Keep in Mind
segments.tr: ## 유의해야 할 사항

segments.src: - **Probabilities are not promises.** A 70% market-implied chance of a rate hike reflects current pricing. It can change quickly with new inflation, jobs or Fed data.
segments.tr: - **확률이 확정된 약속은 아닙니다.** 시장 내재 금리 인상 확률 70%는 현재 가격에 반영된 수치일 뿐입니다. 새로운 인플레이션, 고용 또는 연준 데이터에 따라 빠르게 변할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Avoid reacting to headlines.** Large one-day moves can prompt hasty decisions. Check whether your plan still matches your goals and time horizon.
segments.tr: - **헤드라인에 충동적으로 반응하지 마세요.** 하루 동안의 큰 변동이 조급한 결정을 유발할 수 있습니다. 자신의 재무 계획이 목표와 투자 기간에 여전히 부합하는지 확인하세요.

segments.src: - **Review variable-rate debt.** If you carry credit card balances or an adjustable-rate loan, consider whether paying them down or refinancing makes sense.
segments.tr: - **변동금리 부채를 점검하세요.** 신용카드 잔액이나 변동금리 대출이 있다면 상환하거나 재융자하는 것이 유용한지 검토해 보세요.

segments.src: - **Check your asset mix.** Diversification across stocks, bonds and cash can help manage the impact of rate swings.
segments.tr: - **자산 배분을 점검하세요.** 주식, 채권, 현금으로 분산 투자하면 금리 변동의 영향을 관리하는 데 도움이 될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Look at cash yields.** Idle cash may earn more today than it did a few years ago.
segments.tr: - **현금 수익률을 확인하세요.** 방치된 현금이 몇 년 전보다 오늘날 더 많은 이자를 가져다줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## 앞으로 주시해야 할 것들

segments.src: - The Fed's next policy meeting and its statement and projections
segments.tr: - 연준의 다음 통화정책 회의 및 성명서와 전망치

segments.src: - Upcoming inflation reports, including CPI and PCE
segments.tr: - CPI 및 PCE를 포함한 향후 인플레이션 보고서

segments.src: - Monthly jobs data and wage growth
segments.tr: - 월간 고용 지표 및 임금 상승률

segments.src: - Treasury auction demand
segments.tr: - 미국 국채 입찰 수요

segments.src: - Whether the 10-year yield holds above 5% or pulls back
segments.tr: - 10년물 금리가 5% 위에서 유지될지, 아니면 하락할지의 여부

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 요약

segments.src: A 10-year yield above 5.2% is a notable milestone.
segments.tr: 10년물 금리가 5.2%를 넘어선 것은 주목할 만한 이정표입니다.

segments.src: It reflects expectations of tighter policy for longer and a higher price for borrowing across the economy.
segments.tr: 이는 긴축 정책이 더 오래 지속될 것이라는 기대와 경제 전반의 차입 비용 상승을 반영합니다.

segments.src: For households, that means more expensive new loans and more attractive savings rates.
segments.tr: 가계에는 신규 대출 비용 증가와 더 높은 예금 금리를 의미합니다.

segments.src: For investors, it means more volatility in both bonds and stocks.
segments.tr: 투자자에게는 채권과 주식 시장 모두에서 변동성이 커짐을 의미합니다.

segments.src: Staying informed and keeping a long-term plan are usually more useful than trying to time each swing.
segments.tr: 시장 변동의 타이밍을 맞추려 애쓰는 것보다 지속적으로 시장을 주시하며 장기 계획을 유지하는 것이 보통 더 유용합니다.

segments.tr: 10年期美国

segments.src: Treasury yield closed at **5.244%**, its highest level since 2007.
segments.tr: 国债收益率收于 **5.244%**，创下自2007年以来的最高水平。

segments.src: Traders are also pricing roughly a **70% chance** of another Federal Reserve rate hike in October, according to market-implied probabilities.
segments.tr: 根据市场隐含概率，交易员还预计美联储在10月再次加息的可能性约为 **70%**。

segments.tr: 在同一交易时段，黄金价格下跌了约 **3.7%**。

segments.tr: 本文解释了债券市场可能发出的信号，以及更高的收益率如何影响日常财务。

segments.src: ## What the 10-Year Yield Measures
segments.tr: ## 10年期国债收益率衡量什么

segments.src: The 10-year Treasury yield is the annual return investors earn by lending money to the U.S.
segments.tr: 10年期国债收益率是投资者通过借钱给美国

segments.src: government for a decade.
segments.tr: 政府十年所获得的年度回报。

segments.src: Bond prices and yields move in opposite directions.
segments.tr: 债券价格与收益率呈反向变动。

segments.src: When investors sell Treasuries, prices fall and yields rise.
segments.tr: 当投资者抛售国债时，价格下跌，收益率上升。

segments.src: The 10-year yield is often called the benchmark for global borrowing costs.
segments.tr: 10年期国债收益率通常被称为全球借贷成本的基准。

segments.src: Many other rates are priced relative to it, including mortgages, corporate bonds and some business loans.
segments.tr: 许多其他利率都是相对于它来定价的，包括抵押贷款、公司债券和一些商业贷款。

segments.src: ## Why Yields Are Rising
segments.tr: ## 收益率为何上升

segments.src: Several forces can push long-term yields higher at the same time:
segments.tr: 多种力量可以同时推动长期收益率走高：

segments.src: - **Rate expectations.** If markets expect the Fed to keep rates higher for longer, or to raise them again, investors demand higher yields on longer-dated bonds.
segments.tr: - **利率预期。** 如果市场预期美联储将长期维持高利率，或再次加息，投资者就会要求长期债券提供更高的收益率。

segments.src: - **Inflation concerns.** Investors want compensation for the risk that inflation erodes the value of fixed payments.
segments.tr: - **通胀担忧。** 投资者希望获得补偿，以应对通胀侵蚀固定支付价值的风险。

segments.src: - **Heavy government borrowing.** A larger supply of Treasuries can require higher yields to attract buyers.
segments.tr: - **政府大量借贷。** 国债供应量增加可能需要更高的收益率来吸引买家。

segments.src: - **Term premium.** Investors may ask for extra yield to hold long-term debt when the outlook is uncertain.
segments.tr: - **期限溢价。** 当前景不明朗时，投资者可能会要求额外的收益率来持有长期债务。

segments.src: No single factor explains a move like this.
segments.tr: 没有单一因素能解释这样的变动。

segments.src: Analysts often disagree about which one matters most.
segments.tr: 分析师往往对哪个因素最重要存在分歧。

segments.src: ## Why Gold Fell Sharply
segments.tr: ## 黄金为何大幅下跌

segments.src: Gold pays no interest.
segments.tr: 黄金不产生利息。

segments.src: When Treasury yields rise, holding gold becomes relatively less attractive compared with bonds that pay a rising, low-risk return.
segments.tr: 当国债收益率上升时，与支付不断上升、低风险回报的债券相比，持有黄金的吸引力相对降低。

segments.src: A stronger dollar can add to the pressure.
segments.tr: 美元走强可能会加剧这种压力。

segments.src: A 3.7% one-day drop is large for gold, and it suggests that traders were reacting strongly to the rate outlook.
segments.tr: 单日3.7%的跌幅对黄金来说很大，这表明交易员对利率前景反应强烈。

segments.src: One day's move is not a trend, though, and prices can reverse.

segments.src: ## How Higher Yields Reach Your Wallet

segments.src: - **Inflation concerns.** Investors want compensation for the risk that inflation erodes the value of fixed payments.

segments.src: - **Heavy government borrowing.** A larger supply of Treasuries can require higher yields to attract buyers.

segments.src: - **Term premium.** Investors may ask for extra yield to hold long-term debt when the outlook is uncertain.

segments.tr: アナリストの間でも、何が最も重要かについては意見が分かれることがよくあります。

segments.src: ## Why Gold Fell Sharply
segments.tr: ## 金価格が急落した理由

segments.src: Gold pays no interest.
segments.tr: 金は利息を生みません。

segments.src: When Treasury yields rise, holding gold becomes relatively less attractive compared with bonds that pay a rising, low-risk return.
segments.tr: 国債利回りが上昇すると、上昇する低リスクの利回りをもたらす債券と比較して、金を保有する魅力が相対的に低下します。

segments.src: A stronger dollar can add to the pressure.
segments.tr: ドル高も圧力となる可能性があります。

segments.src: A 3.7% one-day drop is large for gold, and it suggests that traders were reacting strongly to the rate outlook.
segments.tr: 1日で3.7%の下落は金としては大きく、トレーダーが金利見通しに対して強く反応したことを示唆しています。

segments.src: One day's move is not a trend, though, and prices can reverse.
segments.tr: ただし、1日の動きがトレンドとは限らず、価格は反転することもあります。

segments.src: ## How Higher Yields Reach Your Wallet
segments.tr: ## 利回り上昇が家計に及ぼす影響

segments.src: ### Car loans
segments.tr: ### 自動車ローン

segments.src: Auto loan rates tend to follow broader market rates.
segments.tr: 自動車ローンの金利は、より広範な市場金利に追随する傾向があります。

segments.src: Higher yields can mean higher monthly payments for new borrowers.
segments.tr: 利回りの上昇は、新規借入者にとって月々の返済額が増加することを意味する可能性があります。

segments.src: Existing fixed-rate loans generally do not change.
segments.tr: 既存の固定金利ローンは通常変わりません。

segments.src: ### Credit cards
segments.tr: ### クレジットカード

segments.src: Most credit card rates are variable and tied to the Fed's benchmark rate.
segments.tr: ほとんどのクレジットカード金利は変動制であり、FRBの政策金利に連動しています。

segments.src: If the Fed raises rates, card APRs usually rise within a billing cycle or two.
segments.tr: FRBが利上げを行えば、カードの年率（APR）は通常1〜2回の請求サイクル以内に上昇します。

segments.src: Carrying a balance becomes more expensive.
segments.tr: リボ払いなどの残高を抱えることは、よりコストがかかるようになります。

segments.src: ### Mortgages
segments.tr: ### 住宅ローン

segments.src: Fixed mortgage rates track the 10-year yield closely.
segments.tr: 固定住宅ローン金利は、10年債利回りに密接に連動しています。

segments.src: Higher yields typically push new mortgage rates up, which can reduce affordability for buyers and limit refinancing options.
segments.tr: 利回りが上昇すると、通常、新規住宅ローン金利が押し上げられ、購入者の購入能力が低下したり、借り換えの選択肢が制限されたりする可能性があります。

segments.src: ### Savings and CDs
segments.tr: ### 貯蓄とCD（譲渡性預金）

segments.src: There is an upside.
segments.tr: プラス面もあります。

segments.src: Higher rates often lift yields on high-yield savings accounts, certificates of deposit and money market funds.
segments.tr: 金利が上昇すると、高利回り普通預金口座、譲渡性預金（CD）、マネー・マーケット・ファンドの利回りが上昇することがよくあります。

segments.src: Rates vary by institution, so comparing offers is worthwhile.
segments.tr: 金利は金融機関によって異なるため、比較検討する価値があります。

segments.src: ### Retirement accounts
segments.tr: ### 退職金口座

segments.src: The effect on retirement savings is mixed:
segments.tr: 退職後の貯蓄への影響はまちまちです。

segments.src: - **Existing bond holdings** can lose market value when yields rise, including bond funds in a 401(k) or IRA.
segments.tr: - **既存の債券保有分**は、401(k)やIRAに含まれる債券ファンドを含め、利回りが上昇すると市場価値が下落する可能性があります。

segments.src: - **Stocks** may come under pressure, since higher yields make future corporate earnings worth less today and give investors a competitive alternative.
segments.tr: - **株式**は圧力を受ける可能性があります。利回りが上昇すると、将来の企業収益の現在価値が低下し、投資家にとって魅力的な代替投資先となるためです。

segments.src: - **New savings** can buy bonds at higher yields, which improves future income potential.
segments.tr: - **新規の貯蓄**は、より高い利回りで債券を購入できるため、将来の収益の可能性が向上します。

segments.src: Long-term investors who hold bonds to maturity still receive the stated interest and principal, unless the issuer defaults.
segments.tr: 債券を満期まで保有する長期投資家は、発行体がデフォルト（債務不履行）しない限り、記載された利息と元本を受け取ることができます。

segments.src: That is very unlikely for U.S.
segments.tr: 米国

segments.src: Treasuries.
segments.tr: 国債では、その可能性は極めて低いです。

segments.src: ## What to Keep in Mind
segments.tr: ## 心に留めておくべきこと

segments.src: - **Probabilities are not promises.** A 70% market-implied chance of a rate hike reflects current pricing. It can change quickly with new inflation, jobs or Fed data.
segments.tr: - **確率は約束ではありません。** 市場が織り込む70%の利上げ確率は、現在の価格設定を反映したものです。インフレ、雇用、FRBのデータ次第で急速に変化する可能性があります。

segments.src: - **Avoid reacting to headlines.** Large one-day moves can prompt hasty decisions. Check whether your plan still matches your goals and time horizon.
segments.tr: - **ヘッドライン（ニュースの見出し）に反応しないこと。** 1日の大きな動きは、性急な決定を促す可能性があります。自分の計画が依然として目標や期間に合致しているかを確認してください。

segments.src: - **Review variable-rate debt.** If you carry credit card balances or an adjustable-rate loan, consider whether paying them down or refinancing makes sense.
segments.tr: - **変動金利の負債を見直す。** クレジットカードの残高や変動金利ローンがある場合は、返済や借り換えが理にかなっているか検討してください。

segments.src: - **Check your asset mix.** Diversification across stocks, bonds and cash can help manage the impact of rate swings.
segments.tr: - **資産構成を確認する。** 株式、債券、現金の分散投資は、金利変動の影響を管理するのに役立ちます。

segments.src: - **Look at cash yields.** Idle cash may earn more today than it did a few years ago.
segments.tr: - **現金の利回りに注目する。** 遊休資金は、数年前よりも現在の方が多くの利息を稼げる可能性があります。

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## 次に注目すべきこと

segments.src: - The Fed's next policy meeting and its statement and projections
segments.tr: - FRBの次回の政策会合、声明、および経済予測

segments.src: - Upcoming inflation reports, including CPI and PCE
segments.tr: - CPI（消費者物価指数）やPCE（個人消費支出）を含む今後のインフレ報告

segments.src: - Monthly jobs data and wage growth
segments.tr: - 月次の雇用データと賃金の伸び

segments.tr: - 国債入札の需要

segments.src: - Whether the 10-year yield holds above 5% or pulls back

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: A 10-year yield above 5.2% is a notable milestone.
segments.tr: 10年債利回りが5.2%を超えたことは注目すべき節目です。

segments.src: It reflects expectations of tighter policy for longer and a higher price for borrowing across the economy.
segments.tr: これは、より厳しい政策がより長く続くという予想と、経済全体における借入コストの上昇を反映しています。

segments.src: For households, that means more expensive new loans and more attractive savings rates.
segments.tr: 家計にとっては、新規ローンのコスト増と、より魅力的な貯蓄金利を意味します。

segments.src: For investors, it means more volatility in both bonds and stocks.
segments.tr: 投資家にとっては、債券と株式の両方でボラティリティ（変動性）が高まることを意味します。

segments.src: Staying informed and keeping a long-term plan are usually more useful than trying to time each swing.
segments.tr: 情報を把握し、長期的な計画を維持することは、個々の変動に合わせてタイミングを計ろうとするよりも、通常は有益です。

segments.src: ## What the 10-Year Yield Measures
segments.tr: ## Was die 10-jährige Rendite misst

segments.src: The 10-year Treasury yield is the annual return investors earn by lending money to the U.S.
segments.tr: Die Rendite 10-jähriger Staatsanleihen ist die jährliche Rendite, die Anleger durch die Kreditvergabe an die US-

segments.src: government for a decade.
segments.tr: Regierung über ein Jahrzehnt erzielen.

segments.src: Bond prices and yields move in opposite directions.
segments.tr: Anleihekurse und Renditen bewegen sich in entgegengesetzte Richtungen.

segments.src: When investors sell Treasuries, prices fall and yields rise.
segments.tr: Wenn Anleger Staatsanleihen verkaufen, fallen die Kurse und die Renditen steigen.

segments.src: The 10-year yield is often called the benchmark for global borrowing costs.
segments.tr: Die 10-jährige Rendite wird oft als Benchmark für globale Kreditkosten bezeichnet.

segments.src: Many other rates are priced relative to it, including mortgages, corporate bonds and some business loans.
segments.tr: Viele andere Zinssätze werden im Verhältnis dazu bepreist, einschließlich Hypotheken, Unternehmensanleihen und einiger Geschäftskredite.

segments.src: ## Why Yields Are Rising
segments.tr: ## Warum die Renditen steigen

segments.src: Several forces can push long-term yields higher at the same time:
segments.tr: Mehrere Kräfte können die langfristigen Renditen gleichzeitig nach oben treiben:

segments.src: - **Rate expectations.** If markets expect the Fed to keep rates higher for longer, or to raise them again, investors demand higher yields on longer-dated bonds.
segments.tr: - **Zinserwartungen.** Wenn die Märkte erwarten, dass die Fed die Zinsen länger hoch hält oder sie erneut anhebt, fordern Anleger höhere Renditen für länger laufende Anleihen.

segments.src: - **Inflation concerns.** Investors want compensation for the risk that inflation erodes the value of fixed payments.
segments.tr: - **Inflationssorgen.** Anleger wollen eine Entschädigung für das Risiko, dass die Inflation den Wert fester Zahlungen schmälert.

segments.src: - **Heavy government borrowing.** A larger supply of Treasuries can require higher yields to attract buyers.
segments.tr: - **Hohe staatliche Kreditaufnahme.** Ein größeres Angebot an Staatsanleihen kann höhere Renditen erfordern, um Käufer anzuziehen.

segments.src: - **Term premium.** Investors may ask for extra yield to hold long-term debt when the outlook is uncertain.
segments.tr: - **Laufzeitprämie.** Anleger verlangen möglicherweise eine zusätzliche Rendite für das Halten langfristiger Schuldtitel, wenn der Ausblick unsicher ist.

segments.src: No single factor explains a move like this.
segments.tr: Kein einzelner Faktor erklärt eine solche Bewegung.

segments.src: Analysts often disagree about which one matters most.
segments.tr: Analysten sind sich oft uneinig darüber, welcher Faktor am wichtigsten ist.

segments.src: ## Why Gold Fell Sharply
segments.tr: ## Warum Gold stark gefallen ist

segments.src: Gold pays no interest.
segments.tr: Gold zahlt keine Zinsen.

segments.src: When Treasury yields rise, holding gold becomes relatively less attractive compared with bonds that pay a rising, low-risk return.
segments.tr: Wenn die Renditen von Staatsanleihen steigen, wird das Halten von Gold im Vergleich zu Anleihen, die eine steigende, risikoarme Rendite bieten, relativ weniger attraktiv.

segments.tr: Ein stärkerer Dollar kann den Druck erhöhen.

segments.src: A 3.7% one-day drop is large for gold, and it suggests that traders were reacting strongly to the rate outlook.
segments.tr: Ein Rückgang von 3,7 % an einem Tag ist für Gold groß und deutet darauf hin, dass die Händler stark auf den Zinsausblick reagierten.

segments.src: ## What the 10-Year Yield Measures

segments.tr: Lợi suất trái phiếu kho bạc 10 năm là lợi nhuận hàng năm mà các nhà đầu tư kiếm được khi cho Hoa Kỳ

segments.src: ## Why Yields Are Rising
segments.tr: ## Tại sao lợi suất lại tăng

segments.src: Several forces can push long-term yields higher at the same time:
segments.tr: Một số lực lượng có thể đẩy lợi suất dài hạn tăng cao cùng một lúc:

segments.src: - **Rate expectations.** If markets expect the Fed to keep rates higher for longer, or to raise them again, investors demand higher yields on longer-dated bonds.
segments.tr: - **Kỳ vọng về lãi suất.** Nếu thị trường kỳ vọng Fed sẽ giữ lãi suất cao hơn trong thời gian dài hơn, hoặc tăng lãi suất trở lại, các nhà đầu tư sẽ yêu cầu lợi suất cao hơn đối với trái phiếu dài hạn.

segments.src: - **Inflation concerns.** Investors want compensation for the risk that inflation erodes the value of fixed payments.
segments.tr: - **Mối lo ngại về lạm phát.** Các nhà đầu tư muốn được bù đắp cho rủi ro lạm phát làm xói mòn giá trị của các khoản thanh toán cố định.

segments.src: - **Heavy government borrowing.** A larger supply of Treasuries can require higher yields to attract buyers.
segments.tr: - **Vay nợ chính phủ lớn.** Nguồn cung trái phiếu kho bạc lớn hơn có thể đòi hỏi lợi suất cao hơn để thu hút người mua.

segments.src: - **Term premium.** Investors may ask for extra yield to hold long-term debt when the outlook is uncertain.
segments.tr: - **Phần bù kỳ hạn.** Các nhà đầu tư có thể yêu cầu thêm lợi suất để nắm giữ nợ dài hạn khi triển vọng không chắc chắn.

segments.src: No single factor explains a move like this.
segments.tr: Không có yếu tố đơn lẻ nào giải thích cho một động thái như thế này.

segments.src: Analysts often disagree about which one matters most.
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích thường không đồng ý về yếu tố nào quan trọng nhất.

segments.src: ## Why Gold Fell Sharply
segments.tr: ## Tại sao vàng giảm mạnh

segments.src: Gold pays no interest.
segments.tr: Vàng không trả lãi.

segments.src: When Treasury yields rise, holding gold becomes relatively less attractive compared with bonds that pay a rising, low-risk return.
segments.tr: Khi lợi suất trái phiếu kho bạc tăng, việc nắm giữ vàng trở nên kém hấp dẫn hơn so với trái phiếu trả lợi nhuận tăng dần, rủi ro thấp.

segments.src: A stronger dollar can add to the pressure.

segments.src: One day's move is not a trend, though, and prices can reverse.
segments.tr: Tuy nhiên, biến động trong một ngày không phải là một xu hướng, và giá có thể đảo chiều.

segments.src: ## How Higher Yields Reach Your Wallet
segments.tr: ## Lợi suất cao hơn tác động đến ví tiền của bạn như thế nào

segments.src: ### Car loans
segments.tr: ### Khoản vay mua ô tô

segments.src: Auto loan rates tend to follow broader market rates.
segments.tr: Lãi suất vay mua ô tô có xu hướng theo sát lãi suất thị trường rộng hơn.

segments.src: Higher yields can mean higher monthly payments for new borrowers.
segments.tr: Lợi suất cao hơn có thể đồng nghĩa với việc thanh toán hàng tháng cao hơn đối với người vay mới.

segments.src: Existing fixed-rate loans generally do not change.
segments.tr: Các khoản vay lãi suất cố định hiện tại thường không thay đổi.

segments.src: ### Credit cards
segments.tr: ### Thẻ tín dụng

segments.src: Most credit card rates are variable and tied to the Fed's benchmark rate.
segments.tr: Hầu hết lãi suất thẻ tín dụng là biến đổi và gắn liền với lãi suất chuẩn của Fed.

segments.src: If the Fed raises rates, card APRs usually rise within a billing cycle or two.
segments.tr: Nếu Fed tăng lãi suất, APR thẻ thường tăng trong vòng một hoặc hai chu kỳ thanh toán.

segments.src: Carrying a balance becomes more expensive.
segments.tr: Việc duy trì số dư nợ trở nên đắt đỏ hơn.

segments.src: ### Mortgages
segments.tr: ### Khoản vay thế chấp

segments.src: Fixed mortgage rates track the 10-year yield closely.
segments.tr: Lãi suất thế chấp cố định theo sát lợi suất 10 năm.

segments.src: Higher yields typically push new mortgage rates up, which can reduce affordability for buyers and limit refinancing options.
segments.tr: Lợi suất cao hơn thường đẩy lãi suất thế chấp mới lên, điều này có thể làm giảm khả năng chi trả cho người mua và hạn chế các lựa chọn tái cấp vốn.

segments.src: ### Savings and CDs
segments.tr: ### Tiết kiệm và chứng chỉ tiền gửi (CD)

segments.src: There is an upside.
segments.tr: Có một mặt tích cực.

segments.src: Higher rates often lift yields on high-yield savings accounts, certificates of deposit and money market funds.
segments.tr: Lãi suất cao hơn thường nâng lợi suất trên các tài khoản tiết kiệm lãi suất cao, chứng chỉ tiền gửi và quỹ thị trường tiền tệ.

segments.src: Rates vary by institution, so comparing offers is worthwhile.
segments.tr: Lãi suất thay đổi tùy theo tổ chức, vì vậy việc so sánh các ưu đãi là rất đáng giá.

segments.src: ### Retirement accounts
segments.tr: ### Tài khoản hưu trí

segments.src: The effect on retirement savings is mixed:
segments.tr: Tác động đến tiền tiết kiệm hưu trí là hỗn hợp:

segments.src: - **Existing bond holdings** can lose market value when yields rise, including bond funds in a 401(k) or IRA.
segments.tr: - **Các khoản nắm giữ trái phiếu hiện tại** có thể mất giá trị thị trường khi lợi suất tăng, bao gồm các quỹ trái phiếu trong tài khoản 401(k) hoặc IRA.

segments.src: - **Stocks** may come under pressure, since higher yields make future corporate earnings worth less today and give investors a competitive alternative.
segments.tr: - **Cổ phiếu** có thể chịu áp lực, vì lợi suất cao hơn làm cho thu nhập doanh nghiệp trong tương lai có giá trị thấp hơn ngày hôm nay và mang lại cho nhà đầu tư một lựa chọn thay thế cạnh tranh.

segments.src: - **New savings** can buy bonds at higher yields, which improves future income potential.
segments.tr: - **Tiết kiệm mới** có thể mua trái phiếu với lợi suất cao hơn, giúp cải thiện tiềm năng thu nhập trong tương lai.

segments.src: Long-term investors who hold bonds to maturity still receive the stated interest and principal, unless the issuer defaults.
segments.tr: Các nhà đầu tư dài hạn nắm giữ trái phiếu đến khi đáo hạn vẫn nhận được lãi suất và tiền gốc đã công bố, trừ khi tổ chức phát hành vỡ nợ.

segments.src: That is very unlikely for U.S.

segments.src: Treasuries.
segments.tr: Trái phiếu kho bạc.

segments.src: ## What to Keep in Mind
segments.tr: ## Những điều cần ghi nhớ

segments.src: - **Probabilities are not promises.** A 70% market-implied chance of a rate hike reflects current pricing. It can change quickly with new inflation, jobs or Fed data.
segments.tr: - **Xác suất không phải là lời hứa.** Khả năng tăng lãi suất 70% do thị trường ngụ ý phản ánh định giá hiện tại. Nó có thể thay đổi nhanh chóng với dữ liệu mới về lạm phát, việc làm hoặc Fed.

segments.src: - **Avoid reacting to headlines.** Large one-day moves can prompt hasty decisions. Check whether your plan still matches your goals and time horizon.
segments.tr: - **Tránh phản ứng với các tiêu đề.** Những biến động lớn trong một ngày có thể dẫn đến những quyết định vội vàng. Hãy kiểm tra xem kế hoạch của bạn có còn phù hợp với mục tiêu và thời hạn của bạn hay không.

segments.src: - **Review variable-rate debt.** If you carry credit card balances or an adjustable-rate loan, consider whether paying them down or refinancing makes sense.
segments.tr: - **Xem xét nợ lãi suất biến đổi.** Nếu bạn đang duy trì số dư thẻ tín dụng hoặc khoản vay lãi suất điều chỉnh, hãy cân nhắc xem việc trả nợ hoặc tái cấp vốn có hợp lý không.

segments.src: - **Check your asset mix.** Diversification across stocks, bonds and cash can help manage the impact of rate swings.
segments.tr: - **Kiểm tra danh mục tài sản của bạn.** Đa dạng hóa giữa cổ phiếu, trái phiếu và tiền mặt có thể giúp quản lý tác động của các đợt biến động lãi suất.

segments.src: - **Look at cash yields.** Idle cash may earn more today than it did a few years ago.
segments.tr: - **Xem xét lợi suất tiền mặt.** Tiền mặt nhàn rỗi có thể kiếm được nhiều hơn ngày hôm nay so với vài năm trước.

segments.tr: ## Những điều cần theo dõi tiếp theo

segments.tr: - Nhu cầu đấu thầu trái phiếu kho bạc

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Điểm mấu chốt

segments.src: A 10-year yield above 5.2% is a notable milestone.
segments.tr: Lợi suất 10 năm trên 5,2% là một cột mốc đáng chú ý.

segments.src: It reflects expectations of tighter policy for longer and a higher price for borrowing across the economy.
segments.tr: Nó phản ánh kỳ vọng về chính sách thắt chặt hơn trong thời gian dài hơn và chi phí vay cao hơn trên toàn nền kinh tế.

segments.src: For households, that means more expensive new loans and more attractive savings rates.
segments.tr: Đối với các hộ gia đình, điều đó có nghĩa là các khoản vay mới đắt đỏ hơn và lãi suất tiết kiệm hấp dẫn hơn.

segments.src: For investors, it means more volatility in both bonds and stocks.
segments.tr: Đối với các nhà đầu tư, điều đó có nghĩa là sự biến động nhiều hơn ở cả trái phiếu và cổ phiếu.

segments.src: Staying informed and keeping a long-term plan are usually more useful than trying to time each swing.
segments.tr: Việc cập nhật thông tin và duy trì kế hoạch dài hạn thường hữu ích hơn là cố gắng canh thời điểm cho từng biến động.

segments.src: ### Car loans
segments.tr: ### قروض السيارات

segments.src: Auto loan rates tend to follow broader market rates.
segments.tr: تميل معدلات قروض السيارات إلى متابعة أسعار السوق الأوسع.

segments.src: Higher yields can mean higher monthly payments for new borrowers.
segments.tr: قد تعني العوائد الأعلى مدفوعات شهرية أعلى للمقترضين الجدد.

segments.src: Existing fixed-rate loans generally do not change.
segments.tr: لا تتغير قروض الأسعار الثابتة الحالية عموماً.

segments.src: ### Credit cards
segments.tr: ### بطاقات الائتمان

segments.src: Most credit card rates are variable and tied to the Fed's benchmark rate.
segments.tr: معظم معدلات بطاقات الائتمان متغيرة ومربوطة بسعر الفائدة القياسي للاحتياطي الفيدرالي.

segments.src: If the Fed raises rates, card APRs usually rise within a billing cycle or two.
segments.tr: إذا رفع الفيدرالي أسعار الفائدة، عادة ما ترتفع معدلات النسبة السنوية للبطاقات (APRs) خلال دورة فوترة أو دورين.

segments.src: Carrying a balance becomes more expensive.
segments.tr: يصبح حمل الرصيد أكثر تكلفة.

segments.src: ### Mortgages
segments.tr: ### الرهون العقارية

segments.src: Fixed mortgage rates track the 10-year yield closely.
segments.tr: تتبع أسعار الرهن العقاري الثابتة عائد الـ 10 سنوات عن كثب.

segments.src: Higher yields typically push new mortgage rates up, which can reduce affordability for buyers and limit refinancing options.
segments.tr: تدفع العوائد الأعلى عادةً أسعار الرهن العقاري الجديدة صعوداً، مما قد يقلل من القدرة على تحمل Costs للمشترين ويحد من خيارات إعادة التمويل.

segments.src: ### Savings and CDs
segments.tr: ### المدفوعات والودائع لأجل

segments.src: There is an upside.
segments.tr: هناك جانب إيجابي.

segments.src: Higher rates often lift yields on high-yield savings accounts, certificates of deposit and money market funds.
segments.tr: غالباً ما ترفع المعدلات الأعلى العوائد على حسابات التوفير عالية العائد، وشهادات الإيداع، وصناديق أسواق النقد.

segments.src: Rates vary by institution, so comparing offers is worthwhile.
segments.tr: تختلف المعدلات حسب المؤسسة، لذا فإن مقارنة العروض تستحق العناء.

segments.src: ### Retirement accounts
segments.tr: ### حسابات التقاعد

segments.src: The effect on retirement savings is mixed:
segments.tr: التأثير على مدخرات التقاعد متباينة:

segments.src: - **Existing bond holdings** can lose market value when yields rise, including bond funds in a 401(k) or IRA.
segments.tr: - **ممتلكات السندات الحالية** يمكن أن تفقد قيمتها السوقية عندما ترتفع العوائد، بما في ذلك صناديق السندات في خطة (401k) أو IRA.

segments.src: - **Stocks** may come under pressure, since higher yields make future corporate earnings worth less today and give investors a competitive alternative.
segments.tr: - **الأسهم** قد تتعرض للضغط، نظراً لأن العوائد الأعلى تجعل أرباح الشركات المستقبلية أقل قيمة اليوم وتمنح المستثمرين بديلاً تنافسياً.

segments.src: - **New savings** can buy bonds at higher yields, which improves future income potential.
segments.tr: - **المدخرات الجديدة** يمكنها شراء السندات بعوائد أعلى، مما يحسن إمكانات الدخل المستقبلي.

segments.src: Long-term investors who hold bonds to maturity still receive the stated interest and principal, unless the issuer defaults.
segments.tr: المستثمرون على المدى الطويل الذين يحتفظون بالسندات حتى استحقاقها ما زالوا يتلقون الفائدة وأصل المبلغ المعلن، ما لم يتخلف المصدر عن السداد.

segments.src: That is very unlikely for U.S.
segments.tr: هذا غير مرجح للغاية بالنسبة لسندات الخزانة

segments.src: ## What to Keep in Mind
segments.tr: ## ما يجب وضعه في الاعتبار

segments.src: - **Probabilities are not promises.** A 70% market-implied chance of a rate hike reflects current pricing. It can change quickly with new inflation, jobs or Fed data.
segments.tr: - **الاحتمالات ليست وعوداً.** يعكس احتمال بنسبة 70% ضمني في السوق لرفع أسعار الفائدة التسعير الحالي. ويمكن أن يتغير بسرعة مع التضخم الجديد أو الوظائف أو بيانات الاحتياطي الفيدرالي.

segments.src: - **Avoid reacting to headlines.** Large one-day moves can prompt hasty decisions. Check whether your plan still matches your goals and time horizon.
segments.tr: - **تجنب التفاعل مع العناوين الرئيسية.** يمكن أن تؤدي التحركات الكبيرة في يوم واحد إلى قرارات متسرعة. تحقق مما إذا كانت خطتك لا تزال تتطابق مع أهدافك وأفقك الزمني.

segments.src: - **Review variable-rate debt.** If you carry credit card balances or an adjustable-rate loan, consider whether paying them down or refinancing makes sense.
segments.tr: - **مراجعة ديون الأسعار المتغيرة.** إذا كان لديك أرصدة بطاقات الائتمان أو قرض بسعر فائدة قابل للتعديل، فكر فيما إذا كان سدادها أو إعادة تمويلها منطقياً.

segments.src: - **Check your asset mix.** Diversification across stocks, bonds and cash can help manage the impact of rate swings.
segments.tr: - **تحقق من مزيج الأصول الخاص بك.** يمكن أن يساعد التنويع عبر الأسهم والسندات والنقد في إدارة تأثير تقلبات أسعار الفائدة.

segments.src: - **Look at cash yields.** Idle cash may earn more today than it did a few years ago.
segments.tr: - **انظر إلى عوائد النقد.** قد يجني النقد العاطل اليوم أكثر مما فعل قبل بضع سنوات.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: A 10-year yield above 5.2% is a notable milestone.
segments.tr: عائد الـ 10 سنوات فوق 5.2% هو علامة فارقة ملحوظة.

segments.src: It reflects expectations of tighter policy for longer and a higher price for borrowing across the economy.
segments.tr: إنه يعكس توقعات بسياسة أكثر تشدداً لفترة أطول وسعر أعلى للاقتراض عبر الاقتصاد.

segments.src: For households, that means more expensive new loans and more attractive savings rates.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للأسر، هذا يعني قروضاً جديدة أكثر تكلفة ومعدلات ادخار أكثر جاذبية.

segments.src: For investors, it means more volatility in both bonds and stocks.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للمستثمرين، فهذا يعني المزيد من التقلبات في كل من السندات والأسهم.

segments.src: Staying informed and keeping a long-term plan are usually more useful than trying to time each swing.
segments.tr: البقاء على اطلاع والحفاظ على خطة طويلة الأجل عادة ما يكون أكثر فائدة من محاولة توقيت كل تقلب.
